BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning members of regional transportation planning organizations representing out-of-state governments or organizations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to members of regional transportation planning organizations representing out-of-state governments or organizations; adding a new section to chapter 47.80 RCW; and repealing RCW 47.80.080.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 47.80 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: A member of a regional transportation planning organization representing a government or organization outside the state of Washington may serve only as a nonvoting member of the regional transportation planning organization or any of its boards.

BillSectionHeader.P: RCW 47.80.080 (Majority vote on state matters) and 2003 c 351 s 2 are each repealed.
